title: Getting started with gsm.vizr
text: Three layers, one owner . gsm.viz JavaScript library: decides bar chart looks behaves, documentation source truth every spec key. gsm.vizr package: vendors one copy gsm.viz bundle, owns R--JavaScript serialization contract, ships Shiny, event proxy plumbing. Report packages — gsm.qtl, gsm.kri, gsm.endpoints rest — build data frames specs hand . wrapper deliberately thin. R lists map 1:1 onto JS spec, second vocabulary learn translation layer fall behind upstream.
